topic: Sodexo's plant-based or low-carbon menu target
claim_a: US page: '33% of our planned menu offerings plant-based' by 2025, scope not stated (AIB-38)
claim_b: Group Integrated Report FY2025: 70% of main dishes labelled low-carbon by 2030, no plant-based share target (CPC-08)
position_taken: Use the group report for the global commitment; neither applies to Vietnam, where Sodexo's operation is unconfirmed
notes: Different metric, scope and year rather than a factual conflict.

claim_a: Lever Foundation via Green Queen: IHG Greater China 30% plant-based menus by 2025 (AFN-38)
claim_b: IHG Responsible Business Report 2024 states no plant-based target (CPC-04)
position_taken: Treat as a regional target reported by a third party, not confirmed by IHG; outside Vietnam in any case
